declaration.preface: At Quality Rubbers, we are committed to conducting business with the highest standards of integrity, transparency, and accountability. We recognize that ethical business conduct is fundamental to building trust with our employees, customers, suppliers, regulators, and other stakeholders.
declaration.declaration:
This policy establishes our commitment to fair business practices, compliance with applicable laws and regulations, and zero tolerance towards corruption, bribery, fraud, or any form of unethical conduct. We aim to ensure that all business decisions are made ethically, responsibly, and in the best interest of the organization and its stakeholders.

We believe that maintaining strong ethical standards is essential for long-term business sustainability and reputation. Accordingly, we promote a culture of honesty, fairness, and responsibility across all levels of the organization.

By embedding ethical principles into our daily operations from procurement and supplier engagement to customer relations and internal governance, Quality Rubbers aims to operate with integrity and contribute to a transparent and responsible business environment.
declaration.scope: This policy applies to all employees, workers, directors, officers, contractors, and any third parties acting on behalf of Quality Rubbers. This policy applies to all business activities associated with the Company’s operations, including interactions with employees, customers, suppliers, contractors, regulatory authorities, and other stakeholders.

policy.monitoring:
At Quality Rubbers, monitoring and reporting are integral to ensuring effective implementation of ethical business practices and continuous improvement in governance standards across our operations. We maintain structured processes to track, review, and communicate our performance in business ethics and compliance.

Performance Tracking: Key parameters related to anti-corruption, conflict of interest, fraud prevention, data protection, and fair business practices are regularly monitored against defined performance indicators.

Periodic Reviews: Governance and compliance data are reviewed at defined intervals to assess effectiveness, identify gaps, and support informed decision-making.

Internal Audits: Routine internal audits are conducted to evaluate adherence to ethical standards, internal policies, and applicable regulatory requirements.

Data Integrity and Documentation: Accurate records and documentation systems are maintained to ensure reliability, consistency, and traceability of governance and compliance data.

Stakeholder Communication: We engage with employees, customers, suppliers, regulatory authorities, and other stakeholders to promote transparency, address concerns, and strengthen ethical practices.

Performance Disclosure: Ethical performance, governance practices, and key initiatives are communicated through internal reporting systems and external disclosures, where applicable.
policy.reviewMechanism:
The Ethical Business Policy is subject to periodic review to ensure its continued relevance, effectiveness, and alignment with applicable laws, regulatory requirements, and organizational objectives.

The Ethics and Compliance Officer is responsible for coordinating the policy review process.

The policy is reviewed at least once every year or earlier, if required, based on regulatory changes, business developments, or stakeholder feedback.

The review process includes assessment of compliance status, effectiveness of governance and ethics practices, progress against defined performance indicators, and identification of improvement opportunities.

Necessary updates and revisions are implemented to strengthen the policy and ensure alignment with evolving regulations, recognized best practices, and organizational priorities.
